name: IC Interface Serial — UART/serial, 1.8V — DIP
description: Through-hole serial interface IC cluster for UART applications operating at 1.8V in a DIP-20 (7.62mm width) package.
selection_hints: Requires a 1.8V UART serial interface in a DIP package.
Needs through-hole mounting with a DIP-20_W7.62mm footprint.
Seeking Tier A interface ICs such as MAX3218.
avoid_when: Surface-mount design is required instead of through-hole DIP.
Operating voltage differs from 1.8V or protocol is not UART/serial.
Package pin count or width differs from DIP-20 W7.62mm.
